body:
The usage ledger now says what each command costs: every result a session reads is counted under its command (a resume, a post, the tests, git, a file read) with what it costs afterwards by staying in the context. You can see the top commands per role, before and after a kit change, and the runs of commands repeated in three sessions or more, the ones worth turning into a script.

### What a session now records
For each tool result: its command, its size in characters, its tokens (characters / 4), and the API calls that followed it until the session ended or a compaction dropped it. The carry is tokens x those calls; its cost uses the cache read price of the model serving then. Commands: `kit.py resume`, `kit.py post`, `kit.py train` (any `.kit/<script> <word>`), `tests`, `git <sub>`, `Read`, `ArtifactData <action>`, `mcp:<tool>`, `py:<script>`, `sh:<program>`. Subagents' commands are added to their session's. A row keeps `commands` (totals) and `cmd_seq` (the first 600 results in order, each with its carry $).

### Commands
- `usage.py show --commands [--role R] [--top N] [--min-sessions 3] [--transcripts GLOB] [--rows F --only]`: per role, the top commands by carry $, each with calls, sessions, characters, tokens, carried tokens and share of the role's tokens; the resumes' share on its own line; then the runs of 2 to 5 commands (at least two different) found in 3 sessions or more, with how many sessions, how many times and their carry $. A run inside a longer listed one with as many sessions is not listed again.
- `usage.py compare --before A --after B --commands [--role R]`: per role, each top command's carry $ and calls per session, before and after, with the change.
- `kit.py commands usage` lists both.

### This session, measured
```
| command | calls | sessions | chars | est. tokens | carried tokens | share of tokens | carry $ |
| sh:sed | 5 | 1 | 51k | 13k | 323k | 6.2% | 0.065 |
| ArtifactData list | 2 | 1 | 19k | 4871 | 151k | 2.9% | 0.030 |
| kit.py resume | 2 | 1 | 6462 | 1616 | 50k | 1.0% | 0.010 |
resumes: 1.0% of this role's tokens (50k carried of 5.2M)
```

### Also
A Ledger test let its detached push run on while its folder was deleted (a flaky error under the parallel run); it now waits for the push lock to go.
